timeline.evidenceText: Though this house is so high, yet everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss; and they will say, ‘Why has Yahweh done this to this land, and to this house?’
Men will clap their hands at him,
He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away,
It will happen in that day that Yahweh will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
I will make this city an astonishment and a hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss because of all its plagues.
Because of Yahweh’s wrath she won’t be inhabited,
All that pass by clap their hands at you.
All your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you.
The merchants among the peoples hiss at you.

This is the joyous city that lived carelessly, that said in her heart, “I am, and there is no one besides me.” How she has become a desolation, a place for animals to lie down in! Everyone who passes by her will hiss, and shake their fists.
I will signal for them, and gather them;

definitions.full: H8319. sharaq שָׁרַק verb hiss , perhaps also whistle, pipe (Late Hebrew id., hiss (dubious), Aramaic שְׁרֵיק id. ᵑ7 Lev 2:15-16 , id. ; — from ׳שׁ comes Greek σῦριγξ according to Lag Abh GGW xxvi. 38 Lewy Fremdw.165 ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular consecutive ׳וְשׁ Isa 5:26 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִשְׁרֹק 7:18 + ( Job 27:23 read יִשְׁרְקוּ Me Bi Siegf Bu); 1 singular אֶשְׁרְקָה Zech 10:8 ; — hiss , as signal, ל person, figurative, ׳י subject: Isa 5:26 ; 7:18 ; Zech 10:1 ; in derision, עַל civitat., etc. (often + שָׁמֵם be astounded ), Jer 19:8 ; 49:17 ; 50:13 ; Lam 2:15 (+ ראֹשׁ הֵנִיעַ ), Ezek 27:36 ; absolute Zeph 2:15 ; Lam 2:16 ; 1Kin 9:8 (+ שֵׁן חָרַק ); עַל person Job 27:23 (with מִן local). שׁרק ( שְׁרֵיק ᵑ7 , Syriac , Biblical Hebrew שָׁרַק hiss, whistle (onomatopoetic).
